contexts.text: He gave Zipporah his daughter to Moses () = that he adjoined to him the good of his Church... Zipporah = the quality of the good of that Church.
This is signified by the circumcision of her son by Zipporah.
Zipporah took a piece of rock () = the quality shown by the representative Church through truth; for Zipporah = the representative Church.

Jethro... took Zipporah the wife of Moses () = good from the Divine conjoined with truth Divine... For Zipporah the wife of Moses = good Divine. Explained. ( = the good that is derived from Divine good (Jethro), and is conjoined with truth Divine (Moses). AC 8661.)
